LanguageData.DOL_UseScrollWheelTip: Scroll over a priority box in the Work tab to cycle its priority, or to toggle the work type when manual priorities are off.
LanguageData.DOL_HeaderInclinedTip: Tilts the headers so narrow columns stay readable.
LanguageData.DOL_HeaderVerticalTip: Turns the headers on their side, for the narrowest columns.
LanguageData.DOL_HeaderVerticalRotatedTip: Stacks the first letters of each header top to bottom. Suits languages with fixed-width characters, such as Chinese.
LanguageData.DOL_HeaderHorizontalTip: Leaves the headers as the game draws them.
